publication.label: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · high+OpenCode
publication.selection: First completed valid attempt, including the authorized infrastructure retry. No best-score selection. All 89 groups have final scores; the earlier partial snapshot remains immutable.
display_notes: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash high + OpenCode 1.18.32: complete snapshot, 89/89 groups scored (15/15 Pipeline + 74/74 SR). 62 passed trials and 27 evaluated nonpasses; no groups remain pending.
The final verilog_pcie_t3 Pipeline completed with checkpoint_2 passed and checkpoint_3 through checkpoint_9 failed: score 1/8 (0.125). Its eight final code archives and test records are included.

The authorized PCIe SR checkpoint_4 infrastructure retry has a valid evaluated nonpass: 79/86 tests passed. Its earlier infrastructure failure remains in attempt history; the first completed valid attempt is selected.
Seed 42, one repeat, 90 physical attempts. Structure-cases continuation; all-cases checkpoint scoring; policy-stopped checkpoints score zero. Publication performs no new inference or RTL evaluation.

DeepSeek time-dependent pricing remains pending; unknown costs do not mean free usage. Historical experiments/runner.py orchestration differs from the frozen framework; full historical framework equality is not claimed.
